response.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM category_totals) SELECT category, average_remaining, total, total - average_total FROM category_totals CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_total IS NOT NULL AND total > average_total;

assumptions.assumption: A budgeted-amount threshold of 75 includes lines with amount equal to 75.

alternatives.interpretation: Only budget lines with an amount strictly greater than 75 qualify.
